blocks.text: The most common biological hazards are allergens, infectious diseases that are transferred from animals to humans, and viral diseases (Figure 16.3).

blocks.alt: Four cards with simple icons: microbes (a rod-shaped bacterium and a spiky virus), plants (a leaf with pollen grains, for allergens and toxins), animals (a paw print, for diseases passed to people) and genetically modified (GM) agents (a DNA double helix). A note lists the common biological hazards: allergens, infections passed from animals to people, and viral diseases.
